name: macp_task_update
description: TaskUpdate: a non-terminal progress or status update from the active assignee (RFC-MACP-0009 Section 4). No explicit assignee field; runtime validates authorship via Envelope.sender. Sent as message_type TaskUpdate in mode macp.mode.task.v1.

partial_output.description: Opaque partial output; empty if none. Base64-encoded (RFC-MACP-0001 Section 10.3).
